description: Observed-order sweep for grids/cartesian_uniform_2d/rules/godunov_norm_D2_dirichlet_bc driven by problems/godunov_norm_2d_eikonal_dirichlet_mms.esm, binding NX=NY together. Forced-steady eikonal u_t = -S*godunov(u) + S|grad g| with Dirichlet walls gL=gR=gB=gT=0.5 and exact solution g = 0.5 + sin(pi x) sin(pi y); the error is the first-order Godunov truncation S*(|grad g| - godunov(g)) = O(dx + dy). The mirror-ghost edge/corner faces reproduce g's antisymmetric smooth extension so the boundary stays first order; both L2 and Linf fall as O(h) (expected order 1).

scope_excluded.go: rewrite-only port; no makearray lowering / simulator
scope_excluded.typescript: rewrite-only port; no makearray lowering / simulator

blocked_upstream_bindings.rust: Rust hangs at every tolerance tried (loosest reltol 1e-6; all three solvers Erk/Bdf/Sdirk wedge). earthsci-ast-rs's diffsol integrator has no dtmin/max-step fail-fast guard, so on this stiff / non-smooth-min-max / large-AST RHS it drives dt->0 without terminating instead of erroring. Julia (Tsit5) and Python (LSODA) solve it. Remove once the Rust solver gains a step guard.
